html:
G'oya

Har bir imtihonga uning qayta topshirishini LEFT JOIN bilan ulaymiz. Topilsa uning bahosi olinadi, topilmasa birinchi baho qoladi. "Birinchi NULL bo'lmagan qiymat" ni COALESCE beradi.

Yechim

SELECT s.name AS student, sb.title AS subject,
       COALESCE(r.score, e.score) AS final_score
FROM exams e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN subjects sb ON sb.id = e.subject_id
LEFT JOIN retakes r ON r.student_id = e.student_id AND r.subject_id = e.subject_id

retakes ikki ustun bo'yicha ulanadi: talaba ham, fan ham mos kelishi kerak. Namunada Aziz matematikadan 55 olgan, qayta topshirib 75 olgan. Dilnoza fizikani 40 dan 65 ga ko'targan. Qolgan ikki imtihon o'z bahosini saqlaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat student_id bo'yicha ulash. Unda talabaning qayta topshirishi uning hamma faniga yopishadi: namunada Azizning fizikasi 80 o'rniga 75, Dilnozaning matematikasi 90 o'rniga 65 bo'lib qoladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT s.name AS student, sb.title AS subject,
       COALESCE(r.score, e.score) AS final_score
FROM exams e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN subjects sb ON sb.id = e.subject_id
LEFT JOIN retakes r ON r.student_id = e.student_id

Ikki bahodan kattasini tanlash (CASE WHEN r.score > e.score ...). Shart aniq: qayta topshirish bahosi past bo'lsa ham u yakuniy hisoblanadi.

Oddiy JOIN retakes esa faqat qayta topshirilgan imtihonlarni qoldiradi.
